metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills by Karol Novljaković.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Record narrated design walkthroughs and step-by-step tutorials of a real web app: Playwright drives the UI, an animated pointer guides the eye, and Chatterbox, Kokoro or ElevenLabs narrates.

plugins.name: slack-nag
plugins.description: Schedule friendly, backing-off "nagging bot" follow-ups in a Slack thread until someone answers; each nudge checks the thread first and stays quiet once answered.
